# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V8006 manifest_invalid"
description: "sakura.toml is not a valid manifest: the TOML is malformed, a key is unknown, a value has the wrong type, or [package] has no name."
---

An error from the `package` phase. `sakura explain V8006` prints this explanation offline.

sakura.toml is not a valid manifest: the TOML is malformed, a key is unknown,
a value has the wrong type, or `[package]` has no `name`. The message is the parser's and the span
points at the key, the value or the syntax error. Nothing builds or runs until it is fixed. The
manifest has `[package]` (`name`, `version`, `edition`), `[permissions]` and `[verify]`; any other
table, `[targets]` included, is unknown. `[dependencies]` is `V8005` instead. `[permissions]
process` is reserved: `process = []` is accepted and grants nothing, and any other list is
`V8006`, since no std effect starts processes.

Wrong:

```toml
[package]
name = "billing"
[targets]
```

Fixed:

```toml
[package]
name = "billing"
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V8006_manifest_has_targets_table/`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V8006_manifest_has_targets_table/), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

`main.sak`:

```sakura
// An unknown table is `V8006` at its name; `[targets]` is not a manifest table (design §17.239).
pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} { Console.print("hi") }
```

`sakura.toml`:

```toml
[package]
name = "billing"

[targets]
js = {}
```
